narrative.overview:
Sales Brain AI embodies an artisanal, editorial sanctuary crafted specifically for independent merchants and modern makers. Inspired by high-end botanical and ceramic design houses, the interface turns away from sterile, cold-blue software dashboards in favor of warm tactile paper tones, thoughtful negative space, and disciplined typography.

The experience celebrates the craft of commerce. Every screen feels calm, deliberate, and trustworthy—balancing editorial elegance with lightning-fast operational clarity for inventory, township deliveries, and payment verification.
keyCharacteristics: Subtle Layered Tactility (Oatmeal containers and hairline sand borders)

rules.name: The 10% Terracotta Rule
rules.body: Terracotta (#C05A3E) must never overwhelm the canvas. It is strictly reserved for primary actions, current step markers, and confirmed checkout highlights.

rules.name: The Warm Paper Rule
rules.body: Never use pure cold black (#000000) or tech-blue slate (#0F172A, #F0F9FF) as primary backgrounds. Every surface must remain anchored in warm alabaster, oatmeal, or stone.

rules.name: The Editorial Masthead Rule
rules.body: Page titles, modal headings, and brand identifiers must lead in Serif (font-serif) to maintain the signature artisanal feel.

rules.name: The Unambiguous Metric Rule
rules.body: Prices in MMK, township shipping fees, transaction IDs, and quantities must strictly render in Inter or font-mono with medium/semibold weights to eliminate ambiguity.

rules.name: The Material Layering Rule
rules.body: Depth is created through surface contrast (#FAF8F5 background -> #F3EFEA container -> #FFFFFF floating card) and 1px sand borders, never heavy blurry shadows.

dos: Do use #FAF8F5 as the foundation background for pages, cards, and layouts.
Do lead with font-serif (Playfair Display) on main headlines, section titles, and brand touchpoints.
Do reserve Terracotta #C05A3E for primary CTAs, active highlights, and verified markers.
Do use uppercase tracked typography (text-[11px] font-bold tracking-[0.2em]) for category eyebrows and badges.
Do maintain generous whitespace and breathable section padding.
Do keep borders delicate and warm (border-stone-200/60).
donts: Don't use cold saturated blues or dark slate-blue palettes for general admin surfaces.
Don't use harsh pure black (#000000) for text or background buttons—use rich stone (#1C1917).
Don't place heavy drop shadows or vibrant neon gradients behind cards.
Don't use sans-serif exclusively for all titles; preserve the distinctive editorial serif character.
Don't omit Myanmar Unicode legibility enhancements when rendering Burmese script.
